map.[hota] a gambling place.event.0.desc:
In the mysterious "Land of Gambling Luck", an empire known as the "Kingdom of Wagering" has long dominated the global gambling and betting markets. This empire is built upon an unbreakable system of wealth, utilizing precise calculations and risk control to tightly grasp the fate of people across the world.

"Land of Gambling Luck"¡ªa nation that promotes the dream of winning grand rewards with just a small investment¡ªhas long attracted countless dreamers seeking fortune.

However, behind this alluring promise lies an unspeakable secret¡ªthe true identities of all jackpot winners have never been revealed, and the distribution of betting prizes, as well as the lottery process, is shrouded in conspiracy and covert manipulation.

As time passes, this secret gradually corrodes the very foundation of the kingdom. The dark forces that secretly control the betting system have begun to manipulate the empire's future, transforming gambling wealth into an unstoppable force of evil.
map.[hota] a gambling place.event.1.desc: Your subordinates work hard, contributing a great deal of funds for the war effort.
map.[hota] a gambling place.event.2.desc:
The Minister of Finance announced another tax policy decreed by Kosim. Every castle in the region was now required to pay 2,500 gold coins every week. This increased your tax burden by 50%, leaving you with very little of your weekly income. Enraged, you slammed your head against the wall, but in the end, you dutifully handed over the money.

You understood well that while Kosim might not directly punish you for not paying, the entire castle would be doomed forever if you didn't comply.
map.[hota] a gambling place.event.3.desc:
That day, while rummaging through the cellar of your castle, you unexpectedly found a gemstone. You recalled that when you were a child, your grandfather¡ªthe greatest magician in the world¡ªhad given you this very stone, and told you, "Child, as long as there is magic energy here, this stone will grant you peace. Just place it in the palm of your hand, and it will float and soar freely."

Now, following your grandfather's instructions, you placed the gemstone in your palm, but the stone didn't move an inch. It remained completely still, with not the slightest sign of life. What could be the reason for this?
map.[hota] a gambling place.event.4.desc: That night, you gathered your companions around a campfire to discuss how to conquer Kosim. Although everyone was dissatisfied with the situation, no one could come up with a solution. The mood was heavy and filled with sadness as the reality of the situation settled in.
map.[hota] a gambling place.event.5.desc:
When everyone discovered that magic had disappeared, they were all left dumbfounded and helpless. The mages, once powerful, now spent their days playing chess, cards, and basking in the sun, becoming aimless troublemakers with nothing better to do.

You wrote letters to the various lords, calling for a united effort to overthrow Kosim, but sadly, the response was underwhelming. Some lords began to support Kosim, while others made up their minds to rebel against his rule. With everyone harboring their own hidden agendas and constantly undermining each other, the only one benefiting from this chaos was the despicable Kosim, who grew more and more invincible with each passing day.
map.[hota] a gambling place.event.6.desc:
Your advisors have finally come up with a "brilliant plan." They suggest that you focus on strengthening your army for the time being, and then defeat the neighboring lords, seizing their troops and resources. By doing so, you'll be able to accumulate enough power to challenge Kosim. Once the time is right, you can confront him once and for all.

The problem is, Kosim's magical power grows stronger each day, and the sooner you act, the more advantage you'll have.
map.[hota] a gambling place.event.7.desc:
As the secret was exposed, the victims rose in rebellion, forming the Victims' Association and hiring the Mage Guild as witnesses to testify against the empire.

These actions naturally caught the attention of the Wagering Empire, prompting its evil sorcerer, Kosim, to take ruthless measures¡ªdraining all magical energy from the land to maintain control.

In defiance of this tyrant, castles across the kingdom began secretly training mages, hoping that one day they could overthrow him and restore peace and harmony to the land.
map.[hota] a gambling place.event.8.desc:
Suddenly, a misty illusion appeared before you, and you immediately recognized the figure¡ªit was Kosim's image. Coldly, he spoke, "Every move you and the other lords make has long been under my control. You dare to secretly train mages, attempting to defeat me? You're dreaming. With just a small effort, I can undo everything you've worked for. Today, I'll show you a little of my power. Do you see this holy vial?" He held up a glass container. "All the magical energy in this land is now contained within this bottle. While you¡¯ve been training your army, I¡¯ve been draining all your magic. Now do you understand, you fool? I am the greatest magician in the world and won¡¯t be tricked by your pathetic schemes!"

In the blink of an eye, the illusion disappeared. You stared blankly at the sky, deep in thought. "To defeat this despicable Kosim, we must unite the forces of all the lords, and face his magic in a final battle with shining swords and steel."

map.[hota] a gambling place.header.rumor: This peaceful and tranquil land once held abundant magical energy. Various skilled magicians would come here to test their abilities and showcase their powers. But that was all twenty years ago.

The legend of "The Light of Fate" spread far and wide¡ªa group of heroes who would challenge the limits of the Wagering Kingdom, uncover the truth, and vow to destroy the very foundation of this dark empire, bringing hope and justice to the world.
Tomb Raiders? Ghost Blows Out the Light? Are you interested?
Some people claim to have won, but in reality, they are just making up stories.
It is said that at the center of the island, there is a gifted magician who teaches people the long-lost magic.
Many people are trafficked and sold abroad as laborers. Be careful!
Every New Year, the news channels start publishing misleading stories, like those about scratch-off lottery tickets.
Don't you find it strange? How come we've never seen any jackpot winners? Is everyone just that low-key?
It is said that there is a magician who has lived for over a thousand years, waiting for a hero. Do you believe it?
I haven't tasted anything rich for a whole month. If only I could heat up some chicken and pair it with a cold beer, I can't imagine how great that would be...
In the southwest, there is an underground mine where many brave warriors who lost were sold as laborers. Perhaps someone there could help you.
The monsters from the Dark Continent are extremely fierce, and no one has ever returned alive.

map.[hota] gelu and hota 20.event.0.desc: There is a rumor about an ancient treasure where a very powerful treasure is stored. Our scouts have set out to listen for information about the location of that treasure.
map.[hota] gelu and hota 20.event.1.desc: After a few days of listening our scouts were able to locate the entrance to the treasure.
map.[hota] gelu and hota 20.event.11.des: The Chartreuse portals are back in action after a long time. This is bad news for us. Prepare your forces to face the oncoming giant armies!
map.[hota] gelu and hota 20.event.13.des:
Hello! I am PMUET the author of this map!

I completed this map last year (2023), however at that time I did not have time to test the map, many people said that the map could not be completed due to missing some artifacts. But don't worry now, I have finished my unfinished work. The map has been 100% tested. All secret passages, artifacts, and bosses can be found and defeated. So don't worry if you can't complete the map again!

If you can find any errors, please don't hesitate to give me feedback, I'm happy for it, thanks!
map.[hota] gelu and hota 20.event.14.des: I have a few things to tell you before start :)
map.[hota] gelu and hota 20.event.15.des: This map is quite difficult than my first map: Gelu and Hota. However, if you find the right direction, it will be very easy. So I hope you won't give up halfway. Let's try to complete this map, discover all its secrets :)
map.[hota] gelu and hota 20.event.16.des: The map has quite a few items for decoration purposes only, of course you can't pick them up.
map.[hota] gelu and hota 20.event.17.des: Our scouts have discovered that NomadShooter has quietly prepared a huge army to take you down! He will attack New Dawn from the east by sea! What will you have to do to face him?
map.[hota] gelu and hota 20.event.18.des: After hearing that both FireBoy and WaterGirl have been held captive by you, the Magic Queen hastened to prepare a massive army of Conflux that is expected to attack you next week. Get ready!
map.[hota] gelu and hota 20.event.19.des: Ever heard of Armor of the Damded? It is a legendary treasure. People say that it has been split into different pieces and hidden around the world. To be able to recreate AMOTD you must meet 4 legendary blacksmiths and give them what they need to recreate the armor! However, you need to find your way underground first!
map.[hota] gelu and hota 20.event.2.desc: The secret entrance is hidden in the bushes behind a Tree of Knoweldge but they don't know which tree it is!
map.[hota] gelu and hota 20.event.20.des: A pirate has appeared near the south coast! However, it seems that he is looking forward to a naval battle at sea rather than landing on land. That's good news for us because he's not an immediate danger!
map.[hota] gelu and hota 20.event.21.des: Another pirate has appeared in the South near our garrison! Our forces are too few at the moment and certainly not against him. Be prepared for a retreat!
map.[hota] gelu and hota 20.event.22.des: There are some secret paths that lead to other secret things. You can completely use the bird's view to detect treasures and secret portals. However I don't recommend using the map editor to spot them!
map.[hota] gelu and hota 20.event.23.des: Like part 1, when you level up Gelu will not be able to learn new skills. However he can learn many new things on his adventure!
map.[hota] gelu and hota 20.event.24.des: Although defeated, the remaining Nomads managed to summon an invincible Knight. It will appear anywhere there are sand dunes so be careful not to face it!
map.[hota] gelu and hota 20.event.25.des: A large army of the dead has awakened and will soon come here from the afterlife!
map.[hota] gelu and hota 20.event.26.des: Some enemies are optional! You can defeat them to recruit them later!
map.[hota] gelu and hota 20.event.27.des: Finally: Enemies will always be alerted if they are about to attack you. So don't worry about surprise attacks!

map.[hota] might and magic.event.0.descr:
You're waking up in the middle of the night from the grave chill enveloping your body. You notice a bleak silhouette approaching you, through the haze. Upon approaching, you recognize the figure, it’s Archibald, the older brother of Roland Ironfist, King of Enroth. The most infamous person, earlier - a pretender to the throne, at present - an outcast. The figure looks real enough, but the phantom trail left behind his movement indicates it’s nothing more than a vision. With a calm and silent voice, he addresses you : 

“So this is the corner the great general has stuffed himself into… This backwater duchy… Had your defeat from the united forces of three nations truly eliminated your will to succeed? You see in what state kingdoms are, the central power is toppled. the capital is lost due to infighting, this piece of land is the only thing left and everything is the consequence of your failure in front of Triumvirat… But this period of misery must end.
I will share some hints I managed to put together - the power that three nations of Triumvirat obtained is not of ordinary origin, neither their dominance follow an ordinary or even rational logic. Triumvirat does not rule over the defeated nations, but decided to put them into the chaos of internal conflicts and instability. The common folks speaks about the advent of Gods, but these four gods are not messiahs, neither they are divine, but the product of artifacts of the Ancients. As much as encountered creations of the Ancient, I now can clearly see what they’re capable of, only the instruments of the Ancients can provide such power.
My brother, Roland, is unfortunately not here, he is still fighting invading forces of Triumvirat on Enroth, and thus I sense a responsibility over the Antagarich. Even though I do not have the power or influence as prior, plus I promised Roland to never leave my exile in Clanker’s Laboratory, but I’m willing to provide my sincere advisory to your campaign against the Triumvirat. This is in our common interest not to allow the catastrophe to happen. As for the rest - you can only count on your forces, I wish you to stay adamant… against all odds.”
map.[hota] might and magic.event.1.descr:
COLONY ZOD

The great spaceship of Kreegans, also known as demons. Kreegans arrived to Antagarich, when Zod slammed into the continent in the area known as Land of the Giants. The ashy crater rises at the crushsite’s place, and deep below the demons continue to expand their domain, digging tunnels, arranging workshops and mines, stuffed with the unfortunate slaves from the list of “lesser” races, when there are not enough of such they wouldn’t disgust of using the unfavoured of their own kind. Pit Lords assigned to this place, consider it as a vacation, there is no greater authority in the colony.
map.[hota] might and magic.event.10.desc:
ISLE OF CHARELEWATER

The second largest island of Empire of the Endless Ocean. It’s characterized by its H-shape form and two peculiar mountains in the northern and southern parts with numerous mines and artisanal workshops around them. Besides the cognominal bay and the main port, the island hosts a big pirate town of Jordanhall with the most famous rum distillery - St. Jordan. The approaches to the port are controlled by the lighthouse situated at the peak of a lonely island right next to the bay, which is also interesting due to its pearl fishing at it’s outer capes.
map.[hota] might and magic.event.100.des:
Archibald:
"We talked about defeating Triumvirat and invading their realms, but it seems we miss an important detail - their holdings are impenetrable, protected by magical gates, activated after their victory against the Antagarich coalition. I puzzled you, but, luckily, I also have a clue. "White Gates" as they are called - were not created by Triumvirat, it's a legacy of old Enroth civilizations, created after the old non-agression pact signed between nations of Enroth, it didn't exist for too long and the magical system is not as stable, but right now, it's playing against us. The Gates can be controlled with the key, in this case, we need a "White Key" and we can find it where it was created in the Cities of Old. Bad thing - it takes a researchers, pathfinders and explorers to allocate one, but I managed to magically trace the path. Scout Eastern Jadame, Tidewater Caverns and Balthazar's Labyrinth, there must be gate leading to the "White Key""

map.[hota] might and magic.event.113.des:
Archibald:
"I managed to achieve certain progress in understanding of Triumvirat's design. Their objectives are still a mystery to me, but I know what they do. People, well-versed in magic, know about Places of Power on Enroth. These are so called natural nodes, which drive magic energy from one place to another. Triumvirat occupied 5 of those and artificially directs magical energy to achieve something I don't know... But these Places are important, if they neglect the world dominance and protection of their kingdoms. in its favor. 

City of Volee, deep in the frozen continent of Vori. Peak Tryglav in the northern part of Eastern Jadame. Emerald Island, isolated in the south-eastern part of the Endless Sea. Undeground Cavern of Blood Caldera, underneath Darqtane Volcano. And one place underground I cannot easily identify... We will need to find them there and distort their manipulation of magical flows.

It will be the easiest to reach Peak Tryglav, first, this is the place where the bulk of Triumvirat's army stands, led by General Tryglav, once known as Alamar. There are a lot of rumors about deviant behaviour of Alamar, it seems as the power granted to Triumvirat slowly wipes their personality to make them more fitting to the role granted to them."
map.[hota] might and magic.event.114.des:
THE TIME OF INCARNATION HAS COME

The Grand Architect is here... 
The essence of Pandora fully manifested in Casmetra's body and roams Enroth in flesh. Her steps will echo with arrival of cosmic abominations and hideous dragons. It's now up to her to decide the kinds that are worthy to live and reproduce. The Grand Selection begins...  

Pandora's Voice thunders in the air over the Enroth and its people :
"Hear me children of the Ancients. I'm Pandora and I'm here to judge on your misdoings. The planet's pitiful state cannot be neglected further, your kind is on the brim of devastation. I will have this tragedy averted. The planet will be entrusted to do those deemed worthy and you... you will be no more..."

NOW THERE IS NOTHING THAT CAN STOP FORCE THAT IS PANDORA, THE GRAND SELECTION WILL INEVITABLY TRANSFORM ENROTH BY HER DESIGN. 
SURRENDER TO YOUR FATE OR PERSIST THE DOOMED WORLD THAT YOU CREATED.
map.[hota] might and magic.event.117.des: The Kingdom lies in ruins, its stocks are exhausted, logistic is inexistant . You are to bear its recovery from the very bottom.
map.[hota] might and magic.event.120.des:
Archibald:
"I made countless attempts to establish the contact with Oracle, and after this long - I actually got a chance to speak with him. Oracle shared a disturbing truth, the entire population of Enroth is in danger. Pandora, the navigator of Ancients, responsible for settling and colonization of Enroth, considered both the initiative and the colonists as failures, which is needed to be fixed... and by fixed she means replaced with worthy species. Considering the struggle of conducting the cleansing indirectly and my brother, Roland. managed to keep repelling Triumvirat's forces until this moment, she developed a plan to manifest in the living body and put the plan in motion firsthand. The Horn of the Abyss and the mysterious witch, Casmetra, searching for it - it was also part of her plan, that failed. As the one who failed, Casmetra will be used as a vessel for Pandora's essence and this is what is happening right now.

There is still so much we do not know, The biggest mystery of the world, Pandora's Boxes so enthusiastically researched by mages far and wide - ended up being exit points of space portals, allowing Pandora to deliver goods and creatures through the space. What an intriguing mechanisms and the way of interaction with them..."
map.[hota] might and magic.event.121.des:
Archibald:
"We're short in time, we need to capture Triumvirat's Citadels and sever the magic flows, powering Pandora's Incarnation. If we do not do this - our chances will diminsh to almost inexistant. YOU HAVE TO DO - THERE IS NO OTHER OPTION THAN TO SUCCEED."
map.[hota] might and magic.event.122.des:
Letter from Archibald : 
"We all lost our chance to save Enroth, as we know it. There is nothing that can stop Pandora, it's only a matter of time until the world will be shaped by her design. Are we really left without an opportunity to try? Is there anything we didn't have a chance to use against her? Maybe there is.. or maybe not...
I take my leave, perhaps I will be able to distract her for a time... Farewell."
map.[hota] might and magic.event.123.des:
WAR COUNCIL - MONTH 8

Archibald:
"It's good to see all of you here tonight. I'll start with sharing the information we have on the Triumvirat.
Our goal is to defeat FOUR "self-proclaimed gods" and their most trusted general.

God of Might. 
The unimagenable strength is what considered divine about him. Extreme carefulness and thoughtfulness is required, since unprepared armies can shatter in pieces in a matter of minutes. Keep in mind, they're not ultimate beings, their 'divinity' is only concentred in one individual aspect. He can be outsmarted and slain.

Immortal
Maneating beast feasting on the lives of his victim, the most monstroud of the four. Dragon teeth are breaking touching his flesh, magnificent weapons leave but a trace, not a scar. His body is hardier than dragon's scale. The challenger finds a slow death, full of embarassment witnessing the helplessness of his armies.

God of Magic
Contemporary magic is but a faint shadow of once brought by the Ancients, this one shows how fearful the magic truly can be. Protecting his divine guard with protective spells, raining fire and blasting enemies from inside. We need to think about ways denying his superiority.

All-Knowing
You might have your prejudices against the one who only wields knowledge and not power. But this one is cruel and wise, he will not succumb to pride, neither distract from his goal. He uses everything he can to leave no chances to his enemies. You need to expect everything from All-Knowing.

The last one is the general of Triumvirat, Tryglav.
He leads a massive army of conscripts, levies and soldiers, he was not blessed with a divine gift unlike 'the gods', he relies only on his own merit.
Do not underestimate him, but he should be the one falling first.

There is one more thing... or rather two...
Dragonfather allied with the Triumvirat, he doesn't play a role in Pandora's Incarnation, but might become a threat in time and there is an Old Undead King, crusaders report that he awoke from his slumber in his collapsed castle. His imprisonment underground can end soon, and we do not know anything about his motives or alliegance with Triumvirat, but I want you to be aware of this.


Xeron:
"It seems reckless to break in without a thoughtful plan. We should not expect an equal opponent we can fight, we rather need to slay these abominations. An army, a plan and resources to conduct it. 
Commanders, here is the first order - ensure the Triumvirat doesn't have any footprint on the continent. Once Antagarich is free of them, we march on Peak Tryglav."

Zydar:
"We must understand weaknesses of these gods, a large army will not solve everything. 
Mages - expedite the artifact hunt, scout the gods and report on the encountered!"

Archibald:
"Everything relies on your preparation. I wish a good luck."

The unimagenable strength is what considered divine about him. Extreme carefulness and thoughtfulness is required, since unprepared armies can shatter in pieces in a matter of minutes. Keep in mind, they're not ultimate beings, their 'divinity' is only concentred in one individual aspect. He can be outsmarted and slain.

Immortal
Maneating beast feasting on the lives of his victim, the most monstroud of the four. Dragon teeth are breaking touching his flesh, magnificent weapons leave but a trace, not a scar. His body is hardier than dragon's scale. The challenger finds a slow death, full of embarassment witnessing the helplessness of his armies.

God of Magic
Contemporary magic is but a faint shadow of once brought by the Ancients, this one shows how fearful the magic truly can be. Protecting his divine guard with protective spells, raining fire and blasting enemies from inside. We need to think about ways denying his superiority.

All-Knowing
You might have your prejudices against the one who only wields knowledge and not power. But this one is cruel and wise, he will not succumb to pride, neither distract from his goal. He uses everything he can to leave no chances to his enemies. You need to expect everything from All-Knowing.

The last one is the general of Triumvirat, Tryglav.
He leads a massive army of conscripts, levies and soldiers, he was not blessed with a divine gift unlike 'the gods', he relies only on his own merit.
Do not underestimate him, but he should be the one falling first.

There is one more thing... or rather two...
Dragonfather allied with the Triumvirat, he doesn't play a role in Pandora's Incarnation, but might become a threat in time and there is an Old Undead King, crusaders report that he awoke from his slumber in his collapsed castle. His imprisonment underground can end soon, and we do not know anything about his motives or alliegance with Triumvirat, but I want you to be aware of this.


Lord Haart:
"It seems reckless to break in without a thoughtful plan. We should not expect an equal opponent we can fight, we rather need to slay these abominations. An army, a plan and resources to conduct it."

Galthran:
"Commanders, here is the first order - ensure the Triumvirat doesn't have any footprint on the continent. Once Antagarich is free of them, we march on Peak Tryglav."

Magister Thant:
"We must understand weaknesses of these gods, a large army will not solve everything. 
Mages - expedite the artifact hunt, scout the gods and report on the encountered!"

Archibald:
"Everything relies on your preparation. I wish a good luck."

map.[hota] might and magic.event.3.descr:
RAVAGE ROAMING

The arid region in the western part of Jadame. This land was once home to ogres, gorgons, and minotaurs, but the latter declined after the opening of a gate to the Plane of Water, causing a lake to form over Balthazar's Lair. The lake quickly dried up with no connection to the Water Plane. However the city of minotaurs irrevocablty flooded, its entrance destroyed, and the surviving part of population cut off from the surface.
Gorgons compactly inhabit the marshy area on the southern part of peninsula, while the central part is in control of the ogres.
The name of the region takes its origin from the physical anomaly happening in the area - quick erosion, creating new canyons and ravines that ravage the area, forcing the population to constantly nomad from one place to another. The only relatively place in the region is the Barbarian Stronghold, previously belonging to Zog, the Ogre Chief, it switched its owner numerous times since then.

Dungeon Lords rarely recongnize an authority above them, thus anyone having it’s own citadel can proclaim himself a ruler of the kingdom of his own. Lady Ursula had designed Bat Fang in a similar manner, the mighty dungeon keep, that would tall over the majestic bat-shaped underground cell. During the unification of Nighon, this city, alongside Damocles, was a contender for the capital until a new city of Malevolantis prevailed.

Sehitwa and the capital, Ghanzi, can wait you're not prepared to take these fortresses. Our path lies to a distant island of lizardfolk - Dagger Wound Island. SOUTHERN TATALIA

Wild difficult-to-pass part of Tatalian marshes, covered with deep thickets and predacious wildlife, including flying serpents, alligators. venomous toads and much larger representatives of Tatalia’s fauna. The northern coast of the region even though flat, is unpassable and unapproachable, due to muddy grounds, algae forests and ravenous plants hiding among them. The only ferring place is located in the southwestern part, close to mountain range that separates Tatalia from Tidewater. This bay sometimes serves Regna pirates as a transhipment point. Pirates rarely stay for long, since swampfolk is not the most hospitable one, even though the care little about the bay.

Archibald:
"We talked about defeating Triumvirat and invading their realms, but it seems we miss an important detail - their holdings are impenetrable, protected by magical gates, activated after their victory against the Antagarich coalition. I puzzled you, but, luckily, I also have a clue. "White Gates" as they are called - were not created by Triumvirat, it's a legacy of old Enroth civilizations, created after the old non-agression pact signed between nations of Enroth, it didn't exist for too long and the magical system is not as stable, but right now, it's playing against us. The Gates can be controlled with the key, in this case, we need a "White Key" and we can find it where it was created in the Cities of Old. Bad thing - it takes a researchers, pathfinders and explorers to allocate one, but I managed to magically trace the path. Scout Eastern Jadame, Tidewater Caverns and Balthazar's Labyrinth, there must be gate leading to the "White Key""

"White Gates" as they are called - were not created by Triumvirat, it's a legacy of old Enroth civilizations, created after the old non-agression pact signed between nations of Enroth, it didn't exist for too long and the magical system is not as stable, but right now, it's playing against us. The Gates can be controlled with the key, in this case, we need a "White Key" and we can find it where it was created in the Cities of Old. Bad thing - it takes a researchers, pathfinders and explorers to allocate one, but I managed to magically trace the path. Scout Eastern Jadame, Tidewater Caverns and Balthazar's Labyrinth, there must be gate leading to the "White Key""

map.[hota] might and magic.header.descri:
One-Map Campaign based on the most detailed recreation of the world of Enroth. Explore Antagarich, Vori, Nighon, Western and Eastern Jadame, as well as intricate secrets of the underground. Lead one of the seven nations to challenge the Divine Alliance of three nations, the Triumvirat.
Technocrat
map.[hota] might and magic.header.name: Might and Magic HOTA v1.2
map.[hota] might and magic.heroes.102.bi: The past of this individual was completely erased by the moment he received the Mandate and unimaginable might associated with it.
map.[hota] might and magic.heroes.138.bi: Growing up next to the ocean bordering Avlee, Ciele always felt a bond with the ancient waters. She has wandered the lands seeking her calling. Now she finds herself serving the Conflux.
map.[hota] might and magic.heroes.152.bi: Archibald Ironfist was the not-so-good son of Morglin Ironfist who usurped the throne of the Kingdom of Enroth following his father's death, and later served as the ruler of Deyja and leader of the Necromantic Order. At the end he atoned for his sins, helping to rescue his brother Roland from kreegan's prison.
map.[hota] might and magic.heroes.153.bi: The legendary Dragonfather previously perceived as a myth even among other dragons. After the triumph of Triumvirat he suddenly revealed himself, siding with the unprecedented force, which promised him an utopy for dragonkin in exchange of his servitude. He swallowed his dragon pride in the attempt to bring better future for his children... as he questionably considered.
map.[hota] might and magic.heroes.16.bio: The past of this individual was completely erased by the moment he received the Mandate and claimed immortality associate with it.
map.[hota] might and magic.heroes.201.bi: The leader of the mysterious priestesses' cult that worships the sea has stepped out from the shadows not so long ago. Nobody knows who this woman was and where did she came from. However, everyone who met Casmetra mentions her beauty and her power in magic. Many believed that she joined the pirates in pursuit of her own goals. However, with years to pass the priestesses and the corsairs became closest allies.
map.[hota] might and magic.heroes.237.bi: The past of this individual was completely erased by the moment he received the Mandate and knowledge of all things.
map.[hota] might and magic.heroes.24.bio: Maybe by destiny or pure luck, but Coronius accomplished much more in his attempts resisting Triumvirat than others. The only battle won against the Triumvirat was due to his tenacity, the fierce battle between him and newly proclaimed God split the very heaven, The battle where it was proven that "the god" can be slain, this moment earner him the title of Godslayer. Unfortunately the overwhelming forces of Triumvirat suceeded at the end, cornering Coronius. His life was saved by the Phoenix matriarch, who sacrificed the legendary relic called Phoenix Egg, putting Coronius into invulnurable stasis state. In order to mitigate potential risks "gods" of Triumvirat locked his unmoving body deep below the surface, stoneburrying him, so noone could ever free him.
map.[hota] might and magic.heroes.69.bio: The Old Undead King predates the chroniclers of Deyja, noone really knows when exactly this title has been created, since even his disappearance from Deyja is considered ages ago.
map.[hota] might and magic.heroes.74.bio: At a young age, Vidomina showed promise as a great Alchemist, but was driven from Bracada when it was discovered that she had been using her skills not to animate inanimate matter, but to attempt to bring life to previously living creatures.
map.[hota] might and magic.heroes.78.bio: Sandro first studied Necromancy under the tutelage of the wizard, and later the lich, Ethric. Sandro has seen nearly all of Enroth and Erathia, and now serves Finneas Vilmar, leader of the Necromancers of Deyja.
map.[hota] might and magic.heroes.88.bio: Alamar barely remembers anything about his past and self, the moment he was awarded the title of the general, the status slowly absorbed pieces of his individuality until only the title "Tryglav" remained.
map.[hota] might and magic.heroes.90.bio: The past of this individual was completely erased by the moment he received the Mandate and power over magic associated with itt.
map.[hota] might and magic.monster.10.92:
AZURE GROTTO

This dungeon is an illustrious case of Azure Dragons' power and will, underground which earlier was overflown with lava and sulfurous fog is now completely frozen. Snow-covered volcanos, frozen magma and ash are wonders unseen elsewhere. Even the nature can sometimes be subjugated by the will of the mightiest of dragonkind.
But is it only a merit of azure dragons or the everfrozen continent of Vori up above also has its role in it? That's a topic for discussion.
map.[hota] might and magic.monster.101.5: TRIUMVIRAT proclaims the DIVINE HUNT on the head of insolent challenger, who did not bow to the DIVINE PROVIDENCE.
map.[hota] might and magic.monster.114.1:
PORTAL MAZE

In the ancient times, at a place where nowadays Bracada Desert is located, existed the city of magical wonders, that attracted talented mages and enchanters from distant places. This magic paradise was names - Sanctum, and it was the place where first portals and monoliths were created, connecting different lands to Sanctum, allowing mages to discover and research the world and its mysterous.

These stories are century-old and Sanctum remains only a legend, however discovering this part of the portal maze can lead us to its discovery.
map.[hota] might and magic.monster.114.2:
RED DWARF MINES

Ancient and reputable clan of Red Dwarves settled in the desert long time ago. Surprisingly, they didn't find a single ore vein, but sulfur made them thrive, making them the only dwarven clan trading-in sulfur, which made them an outcasts among dwarves. 

Recent incident in Glarean Mines became well-known due to survivor sharing stories about the tragedy in AvLee mines, while Red Dwarf clan being an outcast had neither strong connection with neighbours, nor those lucky ones who managed to escape to the surface. So the rest of the world faced a sudden and abrupt silence from their partners in sulfur trade.
Those groups tasked to scout what had happened with dwarves encountered only poisonous smoke filling the mines and their attempts to push forward were lethal, either from venomous vapors or grotesque dragons that dwell in these poisonous tunnels. 

Noone know what has happened down here. Maybe dwarves themselves dug these horrifiing dragons out or maybe that was entirely something else that drag them here.
map.[hota] might and magic.monster.114.4: TRIUMVIRAT proclaims the DIVINE HUNT on the head of insolent challenger, who did not bow to the DIVINE PROVIDENCE.

"This is a Prison of Insolence. Triumvirat will not forgive anyone daring to threaten the holy mandate to rule. This cell will remain untouched!"
map.[hota] might and magic.monster.13.74:
DRAGON VAULT

The legendary Dragon Vault keeps unimaginable riches, collected through ages of long-lasting lives of dragonkind. One thing is to behold the vault, another is to leave it alive. The cursed abominations, unworthy of dragon name are bound to guard these places for eternity.

map.[hota] might and magic.monster.148.1:
JEBUS

One of the few suitable areas for living in the underworld. Its outer part was first settled by Hakan, the Slavemaster, a couple of decades ago, later followed by Bracada and Nighon outcasts, who opened their secret facilities, studying magic and governance. The university and wisemen in these areas, serve one of the few place, where the ambitious leader can master the true wisdom, art of diplomacy, scholarship and who known what other secrets.

All the colonies are acutely cut from one another by the square-shape mountain range, in the center of which lies something that oftentimes called as "Crossroad" or "Cross". The inner part of the Jebus remains unreachable since the times of first settlers, and you can only guess what secrets and treasures it hides.
map.[hota] might and magic.monster.151.5:
DARQTANE VOLCANO

Furious megavolcano in the center of Jadame. Eruptions and lava flows of Darqtane pose a great threat to nearby lands, even from time to time scorching coastal forests of Northern AvLee. Raging nature attracts evil spirits of fire and earth that dwell and can appear out of nowhere in the smouldering waters of Darqtane Lagoon.

map.[hota] might and magic.monster.175.7:
GLAREAN MINES

The biggest mine on Antagarich, dug and developed by dwarven miners in their attempt of monopolizing crystal trade on the continent. The majority of dwarven banks and riches originate from resources mined in the depth of Glarean Ridge. The unending flow of money was interrupted by the tragic massacre of the colony, that completely shut the mining down. The survivors tell tales of whole central area of Glarean mines collapsing into abyss, forming a gigantic mark of dragon claw. In two days after this collapse unseen dragon-like creature made out from pure crystal climbed from the pit. These crystalized creatures spoke no language only massacred the entire colony in cold blood, forcing survivors to seal the entrance to the surface.

Glarean incident, alongside Red Dwarf Mines, became a disaster to dwarf, almost entirely wiping the dwarven population underground.

map.[hota] might and magic.monster.221.3:
PEAK TRYGLAV

The lonely mountain, that talls over the Eastern Jadame, took its name from its three peaks. Since the ancient times, Peak Tryflav was considered as the place of power and it wasn't as surprsing that Triumvirat built a citadel on each peak to reinforce the control over this land. Supposably, these citadels are used to control the magic flows of the world. What it truly serves is unknown, but its value  to Triumvirat is certain, since it wouldn't be guarded by their most trusted general, who bears the same title - Tryglav.

EMERALD ISLE

South-Easternmost island previously unclaimed by any of the kingdoms. The mixed population was living under the protection of the Morcarack, an ancient and wise dragon. After the triumph of Triumvirat on Antagarich, All-Knowing claimed the island and isolated it from external connection. Numberous refugees fled the island as soon as the new God arrived on its soild, while the former ruler, Morcarack, has mysteriously disappeared without a trace.
map.[hota] might and magic.monster.245.2:
FAERIE POOLS

These empty flooded cells were never of interest to adventurers. The occurance of faerie dragons here brought life to these places, dull and empty tunnels are now flourishing with unique flora and its beauty. Marvelous sapphires, pearls and gems are shining from the bottom of these water attracting treasure hunters, that inevitably find their doom from playful faerie dragons.

Archibald:
"I guess we're somewhere below the Emerald Island, it seems these dragon remains are its former ruler - Morcarak, as it seems Triumvirat brutally got rid of the elder dragon who took care of its people."
DRAGON UTOPIA

Vast underground world hidden from surface dweller's eyes deep in Dragonhead mountains. For so long Dragonfather dreamed of the place where his children could live in peace and he received this gift from the hands of Triumvirat, in exchange for his allegiance. Utopia is equally shared between all dragons, green, gold, red, black, as well as legendary kinds of faeirie, crystal, rust and azure dragons. The shape of Dragon Utopia, forms a large sand cloak, which clearly indicates artificial origin of this place, form. It's phylosophical nature entails the perception of time in the eyes of dragon, which flows differently to lesser species.

Upper chalice of the dungeon belongs to ancient and numerous kinds of chromatic dragons, while the lower chalice is split between rare and mighty bloodlines, whose existence was not known until the very recent time. 

In the neck of the sandcloak rises a wonderous sight - an underground mountain, towering over the Utopia and on its very top sits the Dragonfather himself.
map.[hota] might and magic.monster.27.12:
DRAGONHEAD PENINSULA

Before Vori catastrophe Dragonhead Peninsula had moderate climate. It was a land of dragons and former throne of Dragonfather, who shaped the land in a form of a dragon head, which essentially brough the name to this mountainous land. Cold environment brough a slow decadance to his domain, making him susceptable to Triumvirat's offer - founding a real Dragon Utopia, where dragonkin could rule and live in peace. Once the deal was made Triumvirats godly power opened the underground entrance to a vast undermountain complex, hidden from mortal eyes. A lot has indicate changes that happened to Dragonfather, Bone Dragons once not considered dragonkin, but foul abominations, are now received first step of acceptance. Dragonfather tasked them to guard the gate to Dragon Utopia and take Frozen Dragonhead for themselves.

map.[hota] noble nemesis.header.descript: A cruel king reigns over the land with an iron fist. As tension builds, who will dare to challenge his rule - and at what cost?
map.[hota] noble nemesis.header.name: Noble Nemesis
map.[hota] noble nemesis.heroes.110.biog: Grulk commands the Cyclopes not with words, but with chains and fear. He keeps them fed, focused, and facing the right direction—usually. No one’s sure who’s more dangerous: the monsters in the cage, or the one holding the key.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.heroes.118.biog: Once bred for war, Gorgthak found purpose in chains and walls. Now he guards the angelic prison with brutal pride, crushing escape and mercy alike. Rumors say he’s never slept—only growled. Even demons keep their distance.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.heroes.127.biog: Born in the black waters where sun never reaches, Zsarr'khan speaks the tongue of swamp and serpent alike. His eyes burn like drowned fireflies, and the marsh shifts at his command. Some say the swamp isn't guarded by him—it is him.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.heroes.152.biog: Clad in scorched iron and dragonhide, Varguk calls himself King of the Bad Orcs. He feeds prisoners to wyrmlings and sings to the flames. Even dragons give him space—and that's saying something.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.heroes.20.biogr: Orphaned as a child, Ufretin was raised in the northernmost forests of AvLee. He became known throughout the land for his exceptional ability to resist magics of all kinds.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.heroes.23.biogr: They say Grashka once took down a wyvern with a rusty hook and half a plan. She never speaks of her past—only sharpens her blades by the fire. When she laughs, someone usually dies.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.heroes.31.biogr: Thalanar is said to have been born from the first storm beneath the worldroot. His presence bends light, calms beasts, and silences lies. Few know if he protects the cavern—or if the cavern dreamed him into being.
The Amulet of the Undertaker lies buried deep in the King’s ore mine. Care to fetch it for me? I could help you organize the miners.
Still poking around the tunnels? The ore mine won’t give up its secrets that easily.
