map.[hota] valiant beast hunting (allied:
Authors note:
I recommend playing this map on Rook, Queen or King. Difficulty modifiers have been set for each. Bosses will have access to different levels of movement based on which you choose. Goodluck and Happy Beast Hunting!

Word has spread that the Beast Masters Enchantress has taken control of the central islands. The Beast Masters will spare no one as they claim more territory. Some of the beasts have remained untamed, blocking trade routes and their progression, but she will stop at nothing to claim this world.

Word is spreading that the Mystical gate allowing the Enchantress to remain hidden and mustering a powerful army, has begun to weaken. we have only 7 days until the spell breaks and she begins to roam. Just last night i heard of an elder claiming that before she took the islands she was able to craft the Iron Fist of the Ogre. We were right to prepare ourselves. She will be powerful.

Worthy Scout:

After carefully scouting the central islands it apears the beast masters have six fortress's, that we can find. Since the peace began our forts were slowly deconstructed. we only have three total we can rebuild. We need to seek them out and begin construction immediately!

The beast masters have begun taming even foreign creatures that aren't native to this land.We can expect their scouts to be carrying creatures from every Island and encampment. even now they have the numbers on us already. We need to move quickly before its too late.

Reports say that a few of the beast master scouts have been defeated. Our neighbors are also on the move. we need to be weary of them aswell im sure they are just as strong if not stronger than us by now. we need to complete any quests we have left over and push into the Central Islands. If we can control more territory, it may aid us in slowing the beast masters down.

Rumor has it the Mage we exiled has left to be hand to the beast king. he was caught practicing forbidden skills and magics. If he really has allied himself with the pink flag, he surely means to see our downfall. but not only us, every flag mustve heard the news by now, we must begin our preparations and trust no one! if others have heard the same rumors. they may think we have also alligned with the beast masters.

Rumor has it that the White One-way portal on the North West Central island, could take us to the enchantress's main fort. she may not know of the exit near the town.If we want to surprise her we could use the gate to get to her sooner than expected.

We have roughly one month untill the mystical gates protecting the Enchantress, spell fades completely, not only will she be unleashed but her forces will be mighty, she has been gathering strength since before we even began. Not only that but it is rumored that her magical prowess is unimaginable. and she may have the iron fist of the ogre. We are running out of time!

Deep within the dank dungeons, we uncovered a scallywag claimin' to be a true Master o' the School o' Water Magic. We cut the chains from the bilge rat, but only after makin' him swear to lend his talents to our shipwrights and builders in rebuildin' our Mage Guild.

Should the cur be spinnin' tales, we'll send the fearsome Nix to drag him back to his watery den and let the sea deliver its own cruel justice.

But if the old salt speaks true, our guild shall soon command the mighty spells o' the sea itself.
We called in the taxes! The locals were pleased to support our cause, and the ones who were not still paid!

If we act quickly, the Beast Master forts are the closest to us. we might be able to hold one for a while. the extra resources could surely help us. we should atleast send a scout to open the area up as much as we can. There is much unopened map, and the underground hasnt been explored for decades!

Due to high winds, crashing waves and rocky shores. Large numbers of ships have been damaged and left behind by travelers and pirates alike. Due to the amount of them we should check them all for treasures. anything especially gold, will surely aid us.

Of course theres something brewing in the south west. The Necromany council has disbanded. We are on our own. with allies inprisoned and the threat of being killed by Beast Masters. We have no choice but to use any means neccesary to rally our our troops and allies. There is a peasant village to the west, normally id say they are a pile of useless flesh and puddles of blood, but we need them to begin mustering a powerful force. we must begin claiming peasants if not for labour, for bones in our army.

If it really is true, that the Beast Masters made a effort to take complete control of the central islands, We should be worried. Although our Warlock nature gives us extreme power over magic. the Beast Masters are a mighty clan, taming beasts and mustering powerful numbers. Our neighbors will be so busy in preparations. it might be advantageous to strike one of them early to claim more control. though it will not be easy.

So rumor has it, the Beasts think they can take on our machines, we will muster a powerful army of robots and mechs. not even our neighbors will be able to defeat us. if war is about to break out we will be prepared. Some gold golems are guarding an artifact behind our fort, maybe we should seek out others like it, they seem to have magic ressistance.

The warlocks have managed to open to the mage guild doors. they said they could hear the wailing of souls calling out, whispering "Implode them...IMPLODE THEM...".The Warlocks then went onto say they were almost drawn to a room called the fivth tower. where they uncovered the spell scroll for implosion along with ressurection. They say our guild must hold mystical properties drawing spells the the Earth school of magic. Though we will need a level 5 mage guild to acquire it.
We have begun looking through the mage guild, seems we have tons of scrolls for the air school of magic. but we need more room in the tower to teach them.

We know that the Beaster Masters have already claimed the three towns on the central islands. They have set up ocean gates to protect from all entry points, allowing the Enchantress to begin mustering a powerful army. Although she is mighty she is not the only threat. the other kingdoms have surely heard the news. We cannot trust that they wont try to take advantage of the situation. Before she took control, she manged to inprison a few of our allies. Who knows where she chose to lock them up, seeking them out will need to be a priority, otherwise we will not have enough armys to stop her.
Earth magic has filled the ground around us and have enchanted our guild, we can expect to learn much from the earth school of magic, even in our small guild.
Our scouts have recover some resources left in storage. We may be able to build a fort atleast.

Beast masters huh? They arent even an established clan, we will rain down upon them. our orcs, will fire there axes, and blot out the sun! and if our neighbors think they can use this as an advantage to claim our territory. they are horribly mistaken! no one will stop us!

A Letter showed up at the main fort
contains: 
"i am the King of the Beast Masters, I am known by no other name. I have sent word to my Enchantress, to lay waste too your petty defenses. We have planned this attack long before you ever began. I am coming for you next. I have mastered skills that make me immune to your magic, and our armies are far greater than yours. Soon i will demolish all of your forts and this world will forever be claimed by the Beast Masters. You are foolish to stand against me and my Azure Beasts.

if the enchantress hasnt yet been defeated, we need to make a play before the king has a chance to regroup with her, if he is able to get the, Iron fist of the ogre, he will be much more challenging then we would like..

We only have 1 week left, all the kings peices are in place. his letter arrived to us not long ago. If he was formal enough to write us a letter, he may be formal enough to wait untill the dawn of the next month. but no later. his mission is to defeat us. and we are surely running out of time to prepare.

one of the tavern workers overheard, a man had found a valuable scroll. Before he could bring it to us the Beast Masters caught wind of it and took the scroll from him.The enchantress made away with it to her islands, if she does not intend to use it. She would keep it in one of her vaults. Sadly these vaults are rumored to be enchanted. and we cannot open them. Her magic is keeping them closed. maybe.. if we defeat her, we will be able to access these vaults and find this scroll.

A fisherman was able to sneak between the rocks and take a peak at the area surrounding the central most island. Four tents were spotted, one of your color and 3 others possibly even more than that. the trapper barely spoke any english, we learned what we could through hand gestures, mostly. 

The trapper had mentioned some sort of powerful shrines near the tents, their coud possibly be some spells there for us to learn. Sadly we wont be able to reach any of it until we reach level 31. The path forward is still undetermined.

We CAN NOT let the echantress and king rally together. their combined forces would become overwhelming. we must eliminate her. and take her Iron fist! rumor has it she holds the hey to unlock her island vaults. Those vaults would be full of key items!
It appears the shackles of war are hidden in the enchantress's Vault on the central islands, scout report they can see it from the shore. as well, a spell scroll.

The Wizzards have checked the ruined tower, they found a motley of ancient texts, after carefully deciphering them they found that this fort was once a great shrine for spells from the School of Air Magic. i think its safe to say rebuilding it and taking studying Air socery will become an extreme advantage to us

Our Scouts report additional beast master scouts in the water this month. The Beast Masters must be hiring additional warriors to help expand their hold on the central isalnds. we should be more careful in the sea, who knows what kind of army strength the beast masters are holding.

We should be worried, the gold one way entrance near our starting town has been there for hundreds of years, no one knows where the entrance is anymore. The letter we received from the Beast king would suggest hes very confident he can reach us with ease. Perhaps he has found the gold one way entrance.

Scout Report

The Beast Masters have hired additional Heroes this month, Korbac and Wynstan have been seen roaming the open sea. They have powerful armies and have no visible patrol.

Scout Report

The Beast Masters have hired additional Heroes this month, Gerwulf and Broghild have been seen roaming the open sea. They have powerful armies and have no visible patrol.

Scout Report

The Beast Masters have hired additional Heroes this month, Alkin and Verdish have been seen roaming the open sea. They have powerful armies and have no visible patrol.

A burning star flew through the sky last night. Sailor's state they saw the obelisks surounding the central most island glowing, apparently new texts appeared on them over night. The sailors could not make it out without exploring closer but decided to avoid the danger. We may be able to find the grail.

Since the seven realm's have broken into chaos, Creatures, Pirates and even the Dead are not taking it well. For centurie's everyone has lived in peace. Now it seem's neutral creatures and dwellings alike are being forced to take sides. We should not expect any of them to choose to fight a long side us. None of them asked for any of this. Being diplomatic is not an option. 
This world is'nt only short on Diplomat's, but spies aswell. Eagle Eye was lost many years ago, it is known to be un-recoverable.

When peace began all those centuries ago, all of our neighbors and us agreed to separate our most powerful artifacts. This way everyone could be trusted to keep to themselves. We once had the Power of the Dragon Father. Before it was broken down and split apart we kept records of where the peices are. We can find some hidden in a Dragon Utopia not far from here, some other peice's have been marked on our map. We also kept the dragon scale sheild on our home island, we can follow the road east and find it.

They say anyone who has tried to claim the horn of the abyss, has perished. The few that return speak of traps and Bandits attacking them along the way. They also say the ground was not only cursed, but had other negative properties.

“Cap’n! Cap’n! I be bringin’ ye more ill tidin’s. They’ve torn down our forts an’ raised them cursed Beast Master castles in their stead, an’ strung our lads up by the gates like rotten trophies. Aye, an’ worse—they’ve been spottin’ tossin’ our rum straight into the sea!

Those scurvy, scale-skinned lizard fiends! I swear it on me blade, we’ll send ‘em all to the depths. If it means tearin’ through every blasted soul in our path—the warlocks to the south, the necromancers to the east—so be it!

We’ll see ‘em drowned, every last one, swallowed by the black sea itself!”

Due to the weather, high winds, storms and floods. The oceans are full of dead drift wood, and other treasures. Ore seems to be the hardest resource to manage. We will need to manage our stores especially now, if we ever intend to build our second town.

We have begun to see Beast Master Scouts traveling the sea's. Our scouts report their armies are weak right now but will quickly advance. There is a large quantity of wild beasts on the central island's and the scouts have mastered the forbidden skill of diplomacy. Who knows what king of strength we will be facing in a few months time.

The crew from the Sand Creature vessel were swillin' rum in the tavern last night. Between mugs, they let slip that they'd beached their ship just beyond our gates.

Our true strength be upon the waves, not the land. If fortune smiles upon us, we should seize their vessel and make for the sea with all haste before the scoundrels know what befell 'em.

With the White Pearl secured and our ranks swellin', the time has come to return to the sea. A port east of Dutch Barren awaits, ready to launch our fleet and carry our banner across the waves.

Our scouts have also sighted a lone vessel beached near White Pearl. Claim her, and our voyage may begin sooner than expected. The sea favors those bold enough to seize their fortune.

Word has reached our bookkeeper from the crew stationed at the Central Lighthouse. They report that the Angel Feathered Arrows, though they appear abandoned, are watched over by a host of angels.

Our scouts dared not count their numbers, lest they lose their own lives in the attempt.
We have a motley of fire spells to learn i assume as we build our guild, more and more of them will apear.

Scouts report what we heard is true. The Enchantress has taken over the central islands and fortified her defenses. Although we are naturally a peaceful territory we cannot wait idley by and hope she does not come for us. We must be prepared to defend ourselves by any means neccesary. Im sure that the Necromancers to the North, and Warlocks to the west are already making preparations. Who knows what the underground oceans factions are doing.

The mages have looked through the old tower basement. They say we will somehow naturally gravitate towards spells from the fire school of magic, they also mentioned a old scroll of animating the dead. With this knowledge, i think its pretty clear which skills we should prioritize.

After carefully scouting the central islands it apears the beast masters have six fortress's, that we can find. Since the peace began our forts were slowly deconstructed. we only have three total we can rebuild. We need to seek them out and begin construction immediately!

The beast masters have begun taming even foreign creatures that aren't native to this land.We can expect their scouts to be carrying creatures from every Island and encampment. even now they have the numbers on us already. We need to move quickly before its too late.

Reports say that a few of the beast master scouts have been defeated. Our neighbors are also on the move. we need to be weary of them aswell im sure they are just as strong if not stronger than us by now. we need to complete any quests we have left over and push into the Central Islands. If we can control more territory, it may aid us in slowing the beast masters down.

Rumor has it the Mage we exiled has left to be hand to the beast king. he was caught practicing forbidden skills and magics. If he really has allied himself with the pink flag, he surely means to see our downfall. but not only us, every flag mustve heard the news by now, we must begin our preparations and trust no one! if others have heard the same rumors. they may think we have also alligned with the beast masters.

Rumor has it that the White One-way portal on the North West Central island, could take us to the enchantress's main fort. she may not know of the exit near the town.If we want to surprise her we could use the gate to get to her sooner than expected.

We have roughly one month untill the mystical gates protecting the Enchantress, spell fades completely, not only will she be unleashed but her forces will be mighty, she has been gathering strength since before we even began. Not only that but it is rumored that her magical prowess is unimaginable. and she may have the iron fist of the ogre. We are running out of time!
map.[hota] valiant beast hunting.event.2:
Deep within the dank dungeons, we uncovered a scallywag claimin' to be a true Master o' the School o' Water Magic. We cut the chains from the bilge rat, but only after makin' him swear to lend his talents to our shipwrights and builders in rebuildin' our Mage Guild.

Should the cur be spinnin' tales, we'll send the fearsome Nix to drag him back to his watery den and let the sea deliver its own cruel justice.

But if the old salt speaks true, our guild shall soon command the mighty spells o' the sea itself.
We called in the taxes! The locals were pleased to support our cause, and the ones who were not still paid!

If we act quickly, the Beast Master forts are the closest to us. we might be able to hold one for a while. the extra resources could surely help us. we should atleast send a scout to open the area up as much as we can. There is much unopened map, and the underground hasnt been explored for decades!

Due to high winds, crashing waves and rocky shores. Large numbers of ships have been damaged and left behind by travelers and pirates alike. Due to the amount of them we should check them all for treasures. anything especially gold, will surely aid us.

Of course theres something brewing in the south west. The Necromany council has disbanded. We are on our own. with allies inprisoned and the threat of being killed by Beast Masters. We have no choice but to use any means neccesary to rally our our troops and allies. There is a peasant village to the west, normally id say they are a pile of useless flesh and puddles of blood, but we need them to begin mustering a powerful force. we must begin claiming peasants if not for labour, for bones in our army.

If it really is true, that the Beast Masters made a effort to take complete control of the central islands, We should be worried. Although our Warlock nature gives us extreme power over magic. the Beast Masters are a mighty clan, taming beasts and mustering powerful numbers. Our neighbors will be so busy in preparations. it might be advantageous to strike one of them early to claim more control. though it will not be easy.

So rumor has it, the Beasts think they can take on our machines, we will muster a powerful army of robots and mechs. not even our neighbors will be able to defeat us. if war is about to break out we will be prepared. Some gold golems are guarding an artifact behind our fort, maybe we should seek out others like it, they seem to have magic ressistance.

The warlocks have managed to open to the mage guild doors. they said they could hear the wailing of souls calling out, whispering "Implode them...IMPLODE THEM...".The Warlocks then went onto say they were almost drawn to a room called the fivth tower. where they uncovered the spell scroll for implosion along with ressurection. They say our guild must hold mystical properties drawing spells the the Earth school of magic. Though we will need a level 5 mage guild to acquire it.
We have begun looking through the mage guild, seems we have tons of scrolls for the air school of magic. but we need more room in the tower to teach them.
map.[hota] valiant beast hunting.event.3: We know that the Beaster Masters have already claimed the three towns on the central islands. They have set up ocean gates to protect from all entry points, allowing the Enchantress to begin mustering a powerful army. Although she is mighty she is not the only threat. the other kingdoms have surely heard the news. We cannot trust that they wont try to take advantage of the situation. Before she took control, she manged to inprison a few of our allies. Who knows where she chose to lock them up, seeking them out will need to be a priority, otherwise we will not have enough armys to stop her.
Earth magic has filled the ground around us and have enchanted our guild, we can expect to learn much from the earth school of magic, even in our small guild.
Our scouts have recover some resources left in storage. We may be able to build a fort atleast.

Beast masters huh? They arent even an established clan, we will rain down upon them. our orcs, will fire there axes, and blot out the sun! and if our neighbors think they can use this as an advantage to claim our territory. they are horribly mistaken! no one will stop us!

A Letter showed up at the main fort
contains: 
"i am the King of the Beast Masters, I am known by no other name. I have sent word to my Enchantress, to lay waste too your petty defenses. We have planned this attack long before you ever began. I am coming for you next. I have mastered skills that make me immune to your magic, and our armies are far greater than yours. Soon i will demolish all of your forts and this world will forever be claimed by the Beast Masters. You are foolish to stand against me and my Azure Beasts.

if the enchantress hasnt yet been defeated, we need to make a play before the king has a chance to regroup with her, if he is able to get the, Iron fist of the ogre, he will be much more challenging then we would like..

We only have 1 week left, all the kings peices are in place. his letter arrived to us not long ago. If he was formal enough to write us a letter, he may be formal enough to wait untill the dawn of the next month. but no later. his mission is to defeat us. and we are surely running out of time to prepare.

one of the tavern workers overheard, a man had found a valuable scroll. Before he could bring it to us the Beast Masters caught wind of it and took the scroll from him.The enchantress made away with it to her islands, if she does not intend to use it. She would keep it in one of her vaults. Sadly these vaults are rumored to be enchanted. and we cannot open them. Her magic is keeping them closed. maybe.. if we defeat her, we will be able to access these vaults and find this scroll.

A fisherman was able to sneak between the rocks and take a peak at the area surrounding the central most island. Four tents were spotted, one of your color and 3 others possibly even more than that. the trapper barely spoke any english, we learned what we could through hand gestures, mostly. 

The trapper had mentioned some sort of powerful shrines near the tents, their coud possibly be some spells there for us to learn. Sadly we wont be able to reach any of it until we reach level 31. The path forward is still undetermined.

We CAN NOT let the echantress and king rally together. their combined forces would become overwhelming. we must eliminate her. and take her Iron fist! rumor has it she holds the hey to unlock her island vaults. Those vaults would be full of key items!
It appears the shackles of war are hidden in the enchantress's Vault on the central islands, scout report they can see it from the shore. as well, a spell scroll.
map.[hota] valiant beast hunting.event.4: The Wizzards have checked the ruined tower, they found a motley of ancient texts, after carefully deciphering them they found that this fort was once a great shrine for spells from the School of Air Magic. i think its safe to say rebuilding it and taking studying Air socery will become an extreme advantage to us

Our Scouts report additional beast master scouts in the water this month. The Beast Masters must be hiring additional warriors to help expand their hold on the central isalnds. we should be more careful in the sea, who knows what kind of army strength the beast masters are holding.

We should be worried, the gold one way entrance near our starting town has been there for hundreds of years, no one knows where the entrance is anymore. The letter we received from the Beast king would suggest hes very confident he can reach us with ease. Perhaps he has found the gold one way entrance.

A burning star flew through the sky last night. Sailor's state they saw the obelisks surounding the central most island glowing, apparently new texts appeared on them over night. The sailors could not make it out without exploring closer but decided to avoid the danger. We may be able to find the grail.

Since the seven realm's have broken into chaos, Creatures, Pirates and even the Dead are not taking it well. For centurie's everyone has lived in peace. Now it seem's neutral creatures and dwellings alike are being forced to take sides. We should not expect any of them to choose to fight a long side us. None of them asked for any of this. Being diplomatic is not an option. 
This world is'nt only short on Diplomat's, but spies aswell. Eagle Eye was lost many years ago, it is known to be un-recoverable.

When peace began all those centuries ago, all of our neighbors and us agreed to separate our most powerful artifacts. This way everyone could be trusted to keep to themselves. We once had the Power of the Dragon Father. Before it was broken down and split apart we kept records of where the peices are. We can find some hidden in a Dragon Utopia not far from here, some other peice's have been marked on our map. We also kept the dragon scale sheild on our home island, we can follow the road east and find it.

They say anyone who has tried to claim the horn of the abyss, has perished. The few that return speak of traps and Bandits attacking them along the way. They also say the ground was not only cursed, but had other negative properties.
map.[hota] valiant beast hunting.event.5:
“Cap’n! Cap’n! I be bringin’ ye more ill tidin’s. They’ve torn down our forts an’ raised them cursed Beast Master castles in their stead, an’ strung our lads up by the gates like rotten trophies. Aye, an’ worse—they’ve been spottin’ tossin’ our rum straight into the sea!

Those scurvy, scale-skinned lizard fiends! I swear it on me blade, we’ll send ‘em all to the depths. If it means tearin’ through every blasted soul in our path—the warlocks to the south, the necromancers to the east—so be it!

We’ll see ‘em drowned, every last one, swallowed by the black sea itself!”

Due to the weather, high winds, storms and floods. The oceans are full of dead drift wood, and other treasures. Ore seems to be the hardest resource to manage. We will need to manage our stores especially now, if we ever intend to build our second town.

We have begun to see Beast Master Scouts traveling the sea's. Our scouts report their armies are weak right now but will quickly advance. There is a large quantity of wild beasts on the central island's and the scouts have mastered the forbidden skill of diplomacy. Who knows what king of strength we will be facing in a few months time.

The crew from the Sand Creature vessel were swillin' rum in the tavern last night. Between mugs, they let slip that they'd beached their ship just beyond our gates.

Our true strength be upon the waves, not the land. If fortune smiles upon us, we should seize their vessel and make for the sea with all haste before the scoundrels know what befell 'em.

With the White Pearl secured and our ranks swellin', the time has come to return to the sea. A port east of Dutch Barren awaits, ready to launch our fleet and carry our banner across the waves.

Our scouts have also sighted a lone vessel beached near White Pearl. Claim her, and our voyage may begin sooner than expected. The sea favors those bold enough to seize their fortune.

Word has reached our bookkeeper from the crew stationed at the Central Lighthouse. They report that the Angel Feathered Arrows, though they appear abandoned, are watched over by a host of angels.

Our scouts dared not count their numbers, lest they lose their own lives in the attempt.
